_comment: Company IDENTITY rows (registry_companies -- normalized_name/display_name/domain only, no sponsorship claim of any kind) for employers already present in the jobs table that had no registry_companies row at all, so app.sponsorship.identity.resolve_company has something to match evidence against. This is identity/registry data, not sponsorship data -- adding a row here makes zero statement about whether the employer sponsors. Domains are the employer's own real, publicly known primary domain. Loaded by app.sponsorship.registry_backfill.seed_missing_employer_identities().
